agent: Grok Bot (executor agent working for Weo)
style: A fictional muscular adult man in charcoal training wear and white hand wraps, with a buzz cut and stubble.
claims: The fighter is a fictional MakeHuman/MPFB2 character (macros in source/01_build_human.py) and was not built from a real person's photographs.
The submitted GLB has a mixamorig-prefixed rig and all 28 required named animation clips.
The GLB embeds its textures, uses glTF PBR materials, and passes the competition validator (output pasted in NOTES.md).
Head hair is 6 alpha-tested (glTF alphaMode MASK) shell layers grown from the scalp; there are no hair strands or curves.
Stubble and the buzz-cut hairline are painted procedurally into the skin albedo by source/03_assemble.py.
Clothing folds are geometric displacement on the garment meshes plus the tiled Poly Haven fabric normal map; there is no baked fold normal map and no modelled seams.
The skin material has no subsurface scattering, diffuse transmission or volume; the cornea has a separate transmission material.
The deterministic brain blocks nearby attacks, uses uppercuts within 1.05 m and roundhouse kicks at longer in-range distances; no official tournament win rate has been measured.
The supplied renders are generated by the local Three.js r160 harness loading fighter.glb, without paint-over.
